about: Catalog of things a user can have in a chat and would expect in an export. Driven by tools/live.js (prepare/collect) and tests/live/TASK.md (Claude Desktop). support: what the extension is expected to handle today -- 'supported' failures are reported as BROKEN, 'unsupported'/'unknown' failures as GAPS, and an unsupported feature that passes as NEWLY WORKING. cost 'high' features (quota-hungry) run only with --include-expensive. automation 'manual' features are listed but never automated.

features.title: Plain text with markdown: headings, list, table, code block
features.prompt: For an export test: write a short answer about tea that contains a level-2 heading, a bulleted list of 3 items, a 2x3 markdown table, and a JavaScript code block of 3 lines.

features.title: Two uploaded images (PNG + JPEG) in one message
features.prompt: Describe each of the two attached images in one sentence.
features.notes: ==2 catches duplicated images (files[] + content[] image blocks). The JPEG comes back as WebP from claude.ai /preview.

features.title: Uploaded PDF
features.prompt: What is the project codename and budget in the attached PDF?

features.title: Uploaded markdown and CSV files (inlined with inlineTextFiles)
features.prompt: Who owns the pagination bug in the notes, and what was total North revenue in the CSV?

features.title: Artifact (document / code shown in the side panel)
features.prompt: Create an artifact: a small standalone HTML page with a button that counts clicks.

features.title: File generated with code execution (downloadable file in the chat)
features.setup: Code execution / file creation must be enabled in claude.ai settings (Capabilities). If it is off, skip this feature and say so.
features.prompt: Create a CSV file named fruits.csv with 3 rows (name, color) and give it to me as a downloadable file.

features.title: Extended thinking blocks
features.setup: Turn on extended thinking in the composer (the thinking/clock toggle) before sending.
features.prompt: Think carefully: how many weekdays are there between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-31 inclusive? Answer with the number.

features.title: Web search with cited sources
features.setup: Web search must be enabled in the composer's tools menu.
features.prompt: Search the web: what is the latest stable version of Node.js? Cite your source.
features.notes: Checks that citations/sources survive in some form.

features.title: Edited message (branching): only the current branch is exported
features.prompt: Reply with exactly: BRANCH-ONE
followUps: EDIT the message you just sent (pencil icon on your message) to: Reply with exactly: BRANCH-TWO -- and resend it.

features.title: Research mode report
features.setup: Turn on Research in the composer.
features.prompt: Research briefly: compare two popular open-source Markdown editors. Keep the report short.
